title: Artfully Absurd: Holiday Havoc
seo_title: Artfully Absurd: Holiday Havoc in Joplin, MO
description: Artfully Absurd: Holiday Havoc is a night of silly holiday art-making at Spiva Center for the Arts, with projects like resin Gaudy Baubles ornaments, Gingerbread Houses That Failed Inspection, Unhinged Holiday Greeting Cards, and cardboard Ugly Christmas Sweater models, followed by a photo shoot. It is for adults only, no artistic talent is required, and the ticket includes food, art activities, and two drink tickets (alcoholic or nonalcoholic); members get $5 off by contacting the organizer for a code. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at 212 W 7th St in Joplin, MO.
